text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for accompanying me.
Shall we get going, then—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Off to special saint training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, that day Red Desire and I came to a restaurant where we could enjoy American food. The objective was, of course, "special saint training."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To compete at the BC, and to seize victory――
I, the Saintess Red Desire,
vow to stake my very life upon it."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: All the more reason why my saintly power—nay.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To enhance my American Saintly Power—
the time has come to undertake further discipline!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san, let us begin at once.
First, by getting you accustomed to your daily bread...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff, hot... 
Ngh, ...so hot...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, truly delicious.
Bread dough, cheese, and pepperoni...
A magnificent marriage of pure calories.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"However, yielding to temptation and gorging oneself is taboo for a saint.
Suppressing the urge for 'just one more slice'
might very well be the true trial...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Ouch, hot hot hot...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Together with Red Desire, we continued to take on various menu items after that...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I cherish this rich, bold flavor, but
eventually, the time will probably come when I miss the familiar taste of Japanese cuisine.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Should that come to pass, please do say the word.
I shall dedicate it all to youâ

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: A prayer for the dashi broth.
choice_data_list: (It feels overflowing with both gratitude and flavor.)
(It looks overflowing with both gratitude and flavor.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or maybe she tried casting herself into vast, open spaces inside the VR Umalator just to get used to the 'grand scale'...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, indeed...
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Once upon a time...
Long before this planet was ever born.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Back before I became the Saintess, while I was still drifting through the sky as over 50,000 fragments of holy mana—
choice_data_list: (This conversation suddenly got huge in scale.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And another time, in order to get accustomed
to the car-centric society of that region,
I challenged myself to a fairly long drive.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the drive, Trainer-san.
My, before we knew it, the sun had already set...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, even if you rest here a little longer,
it seems you'll still make it in time for curfew.
Please, feel free to stretch out and relax."
choice_data_list: Yeah, thanks for your concern, Desire.
Yeah, thanks for being considerate, Desire.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I stretched, the distinctive air of the rest stop
filled my lungs.
...Glancing over, I gazed at the expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Red Desire was always positive... but lately, she seemed especially vibrant.
choice_data_list: ...Are you looking forward to the day you can go to the BC?
...Looking forward to the day you get to go to the BC?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire answered without hesitation.
Her eyes were clear, showing no signs that
she was merely staring at some hollow illusion.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What kind of trials await me, I wonder?
Enough to bring me to my knees?
Or perhaps enough to make me collapse entirely?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, yes――yes, I look forward to it all!
Overcoming all of it is what makes it――

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: For I am Saint Red Desire, after all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Now, once we catch our breath,
let's head out, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Our long journey has only just begun.
